title: Exponential-polynomial bound with a constant factor
statement: For all $A,K,k\in\mathbb{N}$, the function $n\mapsto A\,2^{K(n+1)^k}$ is exponential-polynomial: there exist $K',k'\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $A\,2^{K(n+1)^k}\le 2^{K'(n+1)^{k'}}$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$.
